$comment: MC format library. Community-editable: add a recipe here or drop a JSON file with the same shape in formats/community/. Rules: original recipes only (pose, camera move, caption layout); no real people, no copyrighted characters/footage, no named meme sources. The first caption pair is the default. 'scene' must mention 'image 1' (the user's photo). Fields: key, label, emoji, vibe (reaction|chaos|smug|panic|wholesome), scene, motion, camera, captions[{top,bottom}], line (optional spoken line), effect (none|punch_in|shake|boomerang), effect_at (s), frames (4n+1, 81 = ~5 s), fresh (optional bool: show in 'Fresh this week'), negative (optional extra Wan negative terms), caption_layout (optional: classic|edges|top).

formats.label: The Long Stare
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 at an office desk, upper-body medium close-up, looking straight into the lens with a completely flat, unimpressed expression, eyebrows slightly raised, harsh office lighting.
formats.motion: The person holds a completely blank, unimpressed stare into the camera, blinks once very slowly, does not move otherwise.

captions.bottom: you said "we should hang out" and they said "when?"
the meeting could've been an email

formats.label: The Look-Back
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 walking on a sunny city sidewalk, medium shot from the front, mid-stride, head starting to turn over their shoulder, casual outfit.
formats.motion: The person walks forward, then turns their head all the way back over their shoulder to stare at something off-screen with exaggerated interest, mouth slightly open, eyebrows up.
formats.camera: handheld tracking shot walking backwards in front of them

captions.bottom: you said you were going to bed
walking the same way as them

formats.label: The Slow Clap
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 standing alone in an empty theater aisle, medium shot, hands raised in front of the chest about to clap, a faint smirk.
formats.motion: The person claps slowly and deliberately, four big sarcastic claps, with a deadpan smirk and a slight nod.

captions.bottom: when someone actually shows up on time

formats.label: The Side-Eye
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 sitting on a living-room couch, close-up of head and shoulders facing the camera, warm evening lamp light.
formats.motion: The person keeps their head perfectly still while their eyes slowly slide to the side in a suspicious side-eye, one eyebrow lifts, lips press together. Their hands stay down out of frame the whole time and nobody else enters the frame.
formats.negative: hand entering the frame, extra hands, hands near the face, second person

formats.label: Dramatic Zoom
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 in a kitchen, medium close-up with empty headroom above the head, frozen mid-action holding a mug, moody cinematic side lighting.
formats.motion: The person freezes, then their eyes widen in a sudden horrified realization, they slowly lower the mug and stare into the camera.
formats.camera: static camera, then a sudden crash zoom on the face

captions.bottom: I said "you too" to the waiter
your mic was on the whole time

formats.label: Calm in Chaos
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 sitting at a kitchen table holding a coffee cup, medium shot, the room around them is cartoonishly chaotic: papers flying, light smoke, sparks from a toaster, a calm smile.
formats.motion: The person calmly sips coffee and smiles while papers swirl through the air and harmless cartoon smoke drifts around the room behind them.

captions.bottom: you said "how hard can it be"

formats.label: The Dramatic Turn
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 in a dim room, tight close-up with the head turned three-quarters away from the camera, dramatic rim light.
formats.motion: The person snaps their head toward the camera with a wide-eyed, intense, dramatic look and freezes.
formats.camera: static extreme close-up, quick push-in at the turn

captions.bottom: in a conversation I'm not in

formats.label: Mind Blown
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 in a colorful living room, medium shot, fingertips touching their temples, eyes wide.
formats.motion: The person touches their temples, then flings their hands outward miming their head exploding while bright confetti bursts around them.
formats.camera: static camera, slight shake at the burst

formats.label: The Nope Exit
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 standing in an office hallway facing the camera, full upper body, holding a laptop, neutral face.
formats.motion: The person looks at the camera, stops, slowly shakes their head no, then quietly backs away and walks out of frame.

captions.bottom: the party gets a karaoke machine
someone says "let's go around and introduce ourselves"

formats.label: Tiny Victory Dance
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 sitting at a desk with a laptop, medium-wide shot with the whole upper body in frame, fists raised in a small victory pose, big grin.
formats.motion: The person does a big, proud shoulder-shimmy victory dance in the chair, bouncing side to side, grinning, both fists pumping up and down repeatedly.

formats.label: Overconfident Explainer
formats.scene: Put the person from image 1 standing next to a whiteboard covered in messy arrows and circles, medium shot, pointing at the board, very confident expression.
formats.motion: The person points at the whiteboard and explains with total confidence, nodding, talking to the camera.
formats.line: So as you can see, it all makes perfect sense.
